name: Amazon EC2 p4de.24xlarge in us-east-1
description: Published default allocation and regional family listing. Account quota, AZ capacity, usable memory, exact accelerator form factor and current price remain unknown.

provenance.notes: p4de.24xlarge row: eight A100 GPUs, 640GB aggregate GPU memory,1152GiB host RAM, 96vCPU,8x1000GB local NVMe. Host RAM converts exactly as1152*2^30/10^9=1236.950581248GB. Accelerator ref describes shared A100 80GB facts, not an inferred PCIe/SXM variant. Disk is aggregate local instance storage, not persistent checkpoint storage. Omit network guarantee.
p4de.24xlarge default CPU options:48 cores, 2 threads per core, 96vCPU. cpu_cores uses 48, not 96; not a dedicated-host tenancy claim.
US East N.Virginia (us-east-1) lists P4de. P4 page identifies p4de.24xlarge. Regional support does not establish every AZ, account entitlement, available capacity or price. Snapshot active only.
